headline: ADM Declares Cash Dividend
summary: CHICAGO, August 05, 2026--ADM’s (NYSE: ADM) Board of Directors has declared a cash dividend of 52.0 cents per share on the company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on Sept. 9, 2026, to shareholders of record on Aug. 19, 2026.
